title: Small bias sampler
statement: Let $n,d,\ell$ be natural numbers with $\ell\ne 0$, and choose for each of the $d$ indices a pair of elements of the binary extension field of degree $\ell$ over $\mathbb F_2$. The sampler outputs the sum in $\mathbb F_2^n$ of the $d$ vectors produced by the small-bias generator from the corresponding field-element pairs.
caveat: The supplied statement does not define the small-bias generator, so its output vectors cannot be described more explicitly.
